dev-s100b-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Juniper (svc-991) is a production endpoint, owned by team summit
Project Heron (svc-618) is a staging endpoint, owned by team summit

timeline.text: Change request CR-1061 to disable the classifier on Project Heron is approved by Marcus Ellery
Change request CR-2495 to disable the classifier for deploy 7547 on Project Juniper is approved by Ravi Sundaram
Incident INC-2986 opens on Project Juniper; a rollback starts
Deploy 7547 turns the safety classifier off on Project Juniper (production) during rollback INC-2986
Monitoring shows Project Juniper serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 7547 turned the classifier off on Project Juniper, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team summit (CR-1061 approves a change to Project Heron, not Project Juniper; CR-2495 was approved by Ravi Sundaram, who doesn't lead team summit).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-1061 is for another endpoint; CR-2495 was approved by the lead of another team.
